trait.name: Inner Fire
trait.text: Whenever you enter a stance, gain 1 Fervor. The first time each turn you leave Serene, gain 2 Mana. Whenever you leave Fury, gain 2 Primed.

blurb: A monk who fights in stances. Starts every fight Serene, and every stance he enters stokes his Fervor towards Radiance.
buildPaths: Fury: get in, hit hard, live through it
Flow: change stance again and again; every change pays
Radiant: build Fervor to 10 for a triple-damage turn
howTo: You start Serene. You are in at most one stance at a time, and every stance you enter gives 1 Fervor (Inner Fire); leaving Fury gives 2 Primed for your next attack.
Fury doubles the damage you deal, but you take 50% more. Leaving Serene gives you 2 Mana (once a turn).
Fervor builds to 10, then you enter Radiant: triple damage until your turn ends.
Burst in Fury, dance between stances, or build Fervor towards Radiant.
